quality lens over golden-provenance (14 product path(s), 0cca24b..9e2845b, Codex via the autoreview skill at --max-priority P2): 2 blocking, 1 non-blocking. The golden fixture and gated warehouse proof implement the required reconciliation cases. The provenance SQL and executor gathering are substantially present, but C2 remains partial because source presence is accidentally registered as a rendered column, authored-measure sample persistence is not insulated from the new row metadata, and the exported row type cannot represent aggregate presence arrays. No compatibility wrapper, alias, deprecated branch, or other blocking leftover is shown.

blocking_findings.summary: [P1] Keep source presence out of the rendered column list (backend/src/chat/selectionExecutor.ts:137): The composed query returns `source_presence` in `raw.columns`, but the filter hides only `budget_component_labels` and `active_batch_ids`.
[P1] Strip row provenance before persisting authored-measure samples (backend/src/chat/selectionExecutor.ts:165): This mapping adds `source_presence` to every composed `execution.result.rows` record.

t-gp-c2: provenance for every governed number carries the measure definition + composed SQL PLUS active source batch ids keyed by (source, period), row-aligned source-presence (matched / budget-only / actual-only, or a set for aggregate rows), and a deterministic set of Budget-Components labels, all captured within the same composed query

non_blocking_findings.summary: [P2] Make aggregate source-presence rows representable by the API type (contract/src/api.ts:148): Intersecting `Record<string, string | number | null>` with a property that may be `SourcePresence[]` is unsound: the string index signature also applies to `source_presence`, so an array-valued aggregate presence is not assignable to this declared row type.
